01_repository_summary.title: Repository Summary
01_repository_summary.what_repository_does: This tool makes use of Atlas APIs to fetch logs and metrics for multiple NBCUDTC Peacock projects and push them onto Loki and Grafana respectively making it easier for anyone within the organization to get access to MongoDB operational data. There are 6 microservices in this repository all pulling information about MongoDB either from Github or Atlas. The 6 microservices are: 1. atlas-cost-gcs-exporter - This microservice pulls information about MongoDB Atlas cost and pushes it to GCS for FinOps. 1. The production FinOps bucket is mongo-atlas-cloud-cost. 2. We have previously worked with Ying Tao [ying.tao@sky.uk] to grant access to the bucket. 3. Potential improvement is to use workload identity to access the bucket instead of a GCP key provided by FinOps. 2. atlas-cost-usage-exporter - This microservice pulls information about MongoDB Atlas cost and exposes a JSON API for Grafana dashboards. 1. https://prod-grafana-us-east-2.helios-prod.nbcuni.com/d/mongodb-atlas-cost-visibility 3. github-db-driver-version-exporter - This microservice pulls information about MongoDB drivers from Github and pushes it to Prometheus.
